label: Find X6 Pro smartphone
description: OPPO Find X6 Pro — 6.82-inch flagship, Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be after OTA) and 5G sub-6 GHz; USB-C 3.2 with Ethernet over dock.
notes: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be, 2x2, 2.4/5.1/5.8/6 GHz) — OPPO's spec sheet notes Wi-Fi 7 needs a system OTA to enable, so a fresh unit behaves as Wi-Fi 6 until updated. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only (China-market model, no mmWave), dual-SIM. USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with DisplayPort alt mode and Ethernet over adapter (usb0). ColorOS; Chinese ROM has no Google services.
